screens.title: Home, "All files" tab
screens.ads: Native row inside Recent list + docked 60pt adaptive banner above nav
defects: The FAB overlaps the native ad row and its Install button; this breaks the design system own 16pt-clearance rule. Place the FAB so it never overlaps an ad or a tappable row action (>= 16pt gap).
Tile label here is "Folders / Browse"; the destination screen is titled "Directories". Keep as designed and be consistent.

frames: 1 Bookmarks tab populated (3 pinned PDFs, filled bookmarks)
defects: Header here reads "DocView" and shows a more_vert icon; Home (01) uses "Doc View" with search only. Use "Doc View" everywhere.

screens.title: Search screen, 5 states
screens.ads: One in-feed native ad at position 6; NO docked banner
gaps: Recent-searches storage is new behavior (not built yet).

screens.title: Single-file actions: options sheet, rename, delete, details
frames: A Options bottom sheet (520pt, 28pt top radius)
screens.ads: None on sheets; the list behind shows one native ad row
defects: The board nav mentions "Frame C: Annotations" and "Frame D: Export Ops"; these are stale links, no annotation or export UI exists. Ignore.

screens.title: Multi-select and batch delete
frames: 3 List after delete with snackbar "3 files deleted"
defects: Rows show drag_indicator handles in selection mode; there is no reordering on these lists. Do not implement the handles.

screens.title: Directories (folder browser)
gaps: Item counts ("8 items"), page counts ("120 pages") and sort chips are NOT in the current Directories code; counting items per folder may be slow, so compute lazily or omit counts and report it.

screens.title: PDF reader
screens.modes: Light, Dark (white page kept un-inverted), Skeleton, More menu
gaps: "Pages" (thumbnail grid) has no dedicated frame; build a simple thumbnail sheet or hide the button and report. No page-scrubber slider is present in this HTML.

screens.title: PDF reader exception states and dialogs
Office viewer: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX
defects: No screen.png was included in the original zip; use code.html only.
The board text claims a "Rust OpenXML parser"; that is marketing fiction. The app uses the offline_document_viewer package.
The XLSX frame shows a "Filter" chip and a sheet-tab "+" (add) button. The viewer is read-only: omit "+", and omit "Filter" unless you implement it.

screens.title: Image viewer and TXT viewer
frames: TXT light, dark and typography controls
defects: This PNG is large (2046x2853) and readable; the board text about "Bicubic Hardware Sampling" and "NV21 buffers" is decoration.

screens.title: Tools tab (exactly 4 tools)
defects: The labels "Engine 4.18" and "2 Utilities" are board decoration; do not ship them.
Nav label here is "All Files"; Home uses "All files". Use "All files".
gaps: "See All" opens a list of created PDFs; no frame exists for it. Reuse the PDF file-list design.

screens.title: Image to PDF editor and scan review
screens.modes: Light, Dark, Scan review, Empty, Skeleton
defects: Decorative claims such as "Homography 8-DOF" and "Native Skia/PDF 2.0" are board text, not UI.
gaps: "A4 High Res" chip implies a quality option; the current service has only A4/Fit; show it as a static info chip or add a quality option and report.

screens.title: Merge PDF: select, arrange, error
screens.ads: In-feed native ad in step 1 only; no banner
defects: The "iCloud Drive" tab is iOS-only; hide it on Android. Page counts per PDF require opening each document; compute lazily and show a placeholder until known.

screens.title: Split PDF: pick, configure, error
gaps: NEW behavior vs current code: quick-select macros and the "EST" size estimate. Macros are easy (they fill the range field); the estimate can be approximate (pages/total x size) and labelled "~".

screens.title: Operation progress and results
screens.ads: Interstitial only after a successful result, never on launch
defects: The dimmed Tools backdrop in these frames shows 5 tiles (Create PDF, Split PDF, Merge Docs, Compress, tune). That VIOLATES the 4-tool rule. Use the real Tools tab (Image to PDF, Scan to PDF, Merge PDF, Split PDF) as the backdrop. NO Compress tool.
The sample error code "Error 0x82A4" and "142 MB < 350 MB" are invented. Show the real error message; show free-space numbers only if you actually measure them.
The "WASM PDF-Core 3.1ms" text is decoration.
gaps: "Approx. seconds remaining" needs a time estimate; show it only if measurable, otherwise omit.

screens.title: Settings tab
defects: Uses JetBrains Mono for tiny technical labels. Do not bundle a third font; use Inter with tabular figures.

screens.title: Settings sub-screens: theme sheet, scan settings, snackbar
defects: The diagnostics card is Android-only; on iOS hide it.

screens.title: FAQ
defects: Only one answer is written in the mockup; use the answers from Phase 5A for the others.

screens.title: AdMob placements and policy board
defects: Advertiser names (CloudDrive Pro, Google Workspace, Clean Master...) are placeholders. Real creatives come from AdMob; layouts must tolerate any headline/icon.
Mentions "OCR"; there is no OCR in the app.
gaps: This phase builds ad PLACEHOLDER widgets only. Real AdMob SDK integration, consent (UMP/ATT) and ad IDs are a separate phase.
